summary: Mistral's La Plateforme 'Experiment' plan provides free, rate-limited API access to Mistral models with no credit card required. Activating it opts your data into training in exchange for the free tier.
claim_steps: Create a free account at console.mistral.ai.
Activate the free 'Experiment' plan from the subscription page (data-training opt-in applies).
Generate an API key from the API Keys page.
Call api.mistral.ai within the published rate limits.
